history.sourceQuery:
WITH d AS (WITH source AS (
 SELECT a.plan_slug, a.audit_seq, a.audited_plan_revision_id::text AS revision_id,
  a.audited_plan_revision_seq AS revision_seq, r.content_hash AS revision_hash, a.audited_plan_content_hash AS audited_hash,
  to_char(a.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') AS observed_at,
  CASE a.discovery#>>'{readiness,ready}' WHEN 'true' THEN true WHEN 'false' THEN false END AS ready,
  CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(a.discovery#>'{readiness,blockers}')='array' THEN EXISTS
   (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(a.discovery#>'{readiness,blockers}') b
    WHERE b->>'code' IN ('discovery_change_unsupported','discovery_evidence_unusable')
    AND b->>'detail' LIKE '%reconcile the affected conclusion/disposition after changes to%') END AS changed
 FROM harness_shared.plan_audits a LEFT JOIN harness_shared.plan_revisions AS r
  ON r.workspace_id=a.workspace_id AND r.harness_slug=a.harness_slug AND r.plan_slug=a.plan_slug AND r.id=a.audited_plan_revision_id WHERE a.workspace_id='papercusp-workspace' AND a.harness_slug='papercusp' AND a.created_at >= '2026-11-05T00:00:00Z'::timestamptz AND a.created_at < '2026-11-19T00:00:00Z'::timestamptz AND a.audit_kind='discovery'
)
SELECT plan_slug, count(*)::int AS record_count, count(*) OVER()::int AS subject_count,
 jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(audit_seq,revision_id,revision_seq,revision_hash,observed_at,ready,changed,audited_hash) ORDER BY audit_seq) AS records
FROM source GROUP BY plan_slug ORDER BY plan_slug COLLATE "C"), a AS (WITH source AS (
 SELECT a.plan_slug, a.audit_seq, a.audited_plan_revision_id::text AS revision_id,
  a.audited_plan_revision_seq AS revision_seq, r.content_hash AS revision_hash, a.audited_plan_content_hash AS audited_hash,
  to_char(a.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') AS observed_at,
  encode(sha256(convert_to((a.activation->'sourceRanges')::text,'UTF8')),'hex') AS ranges_hash,
  encode(sha256(convert_to((a.activation->'mappings')::text,'UTF8')),'hex') AS mappings_hash,
  encode(sha256(convert_to((a.activation->'itemProvenance')::text,'UTF8')),'hex') AS provenance_hash
 FROM harness_shared.plan_audits a LEFT JOIN harness_shared.plan_revisions AS r
  ON r.workspace_id=a.workspace_id AND r.harness_slug=a.harness_slug AND r.plan_slug=a.plan_slug AND r.id=a.audited_plan_revision_id WHERE a.workspace_id='papercusp-workspace' AND a.harness_slug='papercusp' AND a.created_at >= '2026-11-05T00:00:00Z'::timestamptz AND a.created_at < '2026-11-19T00:00:00Z'::timestamptz AND a.audit_kind='activation'
)
SELECT plan_slug, count(*)::int AS record_count, count(*) OVER()::int AS subject_count,
 jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(audit_seq,revision_id,revision_seq,revision_hash,observed_at,ranges_hash,mappings_hash,provenance_hash,audited_hash) ORDER BY audit_seq) AS records
FROM source GROUP BY plan_slug ORDER BY plan_slug COLLATE "C") SELECT (SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(d) ORDER BY plan_slug COLLATE "C") FROM d) AS discovery, (SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(a) ORDER BY plan_slug COLLATE "C") FROM a) AS activation
missingEvidence: The audit tables do not establish complete independent blocker intervals or causal agent effort.
Role and route interactions require the separate original native capture.

historicalActivity.invocationQuery:
WITH subjects AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT plan_slug FROM harness_shared.plan_audits
  WHERE workspace_id='papercusp-workspace' AND harness_slug='papercusp' AND audit_kind IN ('discovery','activation')
  AND created_at >= '2026-11-05T00:00:00Z'::timestamptz AND created_at < '2026-11-19T00:00:00Z'::timestamptz
), calls AS (
  SELECT i.id, i.invoked_at, jsonb_build_array(i.id::text,to_char(i.invoked_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"'),
     i.tool_name,i.status,i.role,i.coord_owner_id,s.plan_slug,
     CASE WHEN s.plan_slug IS NOT NULL THEN 'audited-subject' WHEN i.args_json->>'slug' IS NOT NULL THEN 'other-subject'
          WHEN i.args_json ? '_batch' THEN 'batch' ELSE 'unresolved-subject' END,
     CASE WHEN i.args_json->>'expectedVersion' ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN i.args_json->>'expectedVersion' END,
     CASE WHEN i.args_json->>'expectedHash' ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' THEN i.args_json->>'expectedHash' END,i.run_id) AS entry
  FROM harness_shared.tool_invocations i LEFT JOIN subjects s ON s.plan_slug=i.args_json->>'slug'
  WHERE i.workspace_id='papercusp-workspace' AND i.harness_slug='papercusp'
    AND i.invoked_at >= '$FROM'::timestamptz AND i.invoked_at < '$UNTIL'::timestamptz
    AND i.tool_name IN ('plans:audit','plans:set-content','plans:launch','plans:start','plans_audit','plans_set_content','plans_launch','plans_start')
), page AS (SELECT count(*)::integer AS total,coalesce(jsonb_agg(entry ORDER BY invoked_at,id),'[]'::jsonb)::text AS events FROM calls)
SELECT total,events,encode(sha256(convert_to(events,'UTF8')),'hex') AS sha256,transaction_timestamp()::text AS observed_at FROM page
historicalActivity.planRunQuery: WITH audits AS (SELECT plan_slug,audit_kind,audit_seq,audited_plan_revision_id::text AS revision_id,audited_plan_content_hash AS body_hash FROM harness_shared.plan_audits WHERE workspace_id='papercusp-workspace' AND harness_slug='papercusp' AND audit_kind IN ('discovery','activation') AND created_at >= '2026-11-05T00:00:00Z'::timestamptz AND created_at < '2026-11-19T00:00:00Z'::timestamptz) SELECT r.id::text AS run_id,r.plan_slug,r.plan_content_hash,r.launched_at::text,r.finished_at::text,r.session_id,r.run_type,r.status,coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(a.audit_kind,a.audit_seq,a.revision_id) ORDER BY a.audit_seq) FILTER (WHERE a.audit_seq IS NOT NULL),'[]'::jsonb) AS matching_audits FROM harness_shared.plan_runs r LEFT JOIN audits a ON a.plan_slug=r.plan_slug AND a.body_hash=r.plan_content_hash WHERE r.workspace_id='papercusp-workspace' AND r.harness_slug='papercusp' AND r.launched_at >= 1793836800000 AND r.launched_at < 1795046400000 GROUP BY r.id,r.plan_slug,r.plan_content_hash,r.launched_at,r.finished_at,r.session_id,r.run_type,r.status ORDER BY r.id

emptyDayControl.query: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM harness_shared.tool_invocations WHERE workspace_id='papercusp-workspace' AND harness_slug='papercusp' AND invoked_at >= '2026-11-11T00:00:00Z' AND invoked_at < '2026-11-12T00:00:00Z') AS any_scoped_invocation, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM harness_shared.plan_audits WHERE workspace_id='papercusp-workspace' AND harness_slug='papercusp' AND created_at >= '2026-11-11T00:00:00Z' AND created_at < '2026-11-12T00:00:00Z' AND audit_kind IN ('activation','discovery')) AS any_scoped_audit
emptyDayControl.positiveControlQuery: SELECT id::text AS id FROM harness_shared.tool_invocations WHERE workspace_id='papercusp-workspace' AND harness_slug='papercusp' AND id=48337745

coverage: Each UTC page preserves the retained direct invocations of the eight spellings in invocationQuery for the recorded workspace and harness. The database computed the SHA-256 of each ordered JSONB text array. An unresolved or out-of-cohort subject retains its original invocation ID.
A top-level slug identifies the audited plan. An expected version or hash describes the submitted CAS baseline. Neither identifies a completed write or proves how much time it cost.
Plan runs use the same UTC bounds on launched_at. A matching audit references the same plan and full content hash. This does not establish that the audit caused the run.
A day with no matching retained calls remains in the denominator. Calls from other harnesses, omitted arguments, indirect dispatches and independent blocks have no inferred attribution.
